concept: Review and integration: service as a sustainable, lifelong practice woven into an ordinary life
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across sustainable contribution, pro bono skill-sharing, and modeling for others — what's your personal throughline?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what service means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
